comment: The herb table: every herb in the world, by rarity. The server loads this file at start-up; the ids are the item ids, so a herb in the bag is a herb in the bag. 'element' is the element it carries. 'time' is the base gathering time in seconds -- the higher the rarity, the longer it takes. 'desc' is the line the gather panel shows under the name.

herbs.name: Wild Ginseng
herbs.desc: The root every beginner pulls first. It teaches the hand more than the herb is worth.

herbs.name: Common Healing Grass
herbs.desc: Dull green blades that close a wound slowly, and a little.

herbs.name: Blue Dew Flower
herbs.desc: Holds a bead of dawn water in every petal. Drink it, or grind it.

herbs.name: Bitterleaf Herb
herbs.desc: Bitter enough to spit out, kind enough to keep.

herbs.name: Earthroot Tuber
herbs.desc: Half tuber, half stone. It sits in the ground and waits to be dug.

herbs.name: Spirit Dew Grass
herbs.desc: Drops of spirit water gather along the blade at moonrise.

herbs.name: Ironleaf Grass
herbs.desc: Grey leaves with a metallic ring. The blade dulls faster than it cuts.

herbs.name: Bloodroot Herb
herbs.desc: The cut root weeps a red sap that closes a wound in one breath.

herbs.name: Frostmint Flower
herbs.desc: Grows where the cold settles, and the petals still carry the chill.

herbs.name: Windwhisper Grass
herbs.desc: It leans with every gust and has never once broken.

herbs.name: Crimson Ginseng
herbs.desc: Red as a banked coal, and it warms the meridians from the inside.

herbs.name: Spirit-veined Orchid
herbs.desc: Pale petals traced with silver veins that hum when the qi runs near.

herbs.name: Golden Core Flower
herbs.desc: A gold heart inside a white bloom. Metal remembers being ore.

herbs.name: Thunderbud Herb
herbs.desc: Closed tight until the storm breaks, then open all at once.

herbs.name: Three-Leaf Spirit Grass
herbs.desc: Three leaves, three breaths. The third one is always the coldest.

herbs.name: Dragonblood Ginseng
herbs.desc: Scarred like a dragon's scale, and sweet as old iron.

herbs.name: Five-Element Petal
herbs.desc: One petal, five colours, and no two are ever the same.

herbs.name: Soul Nourishing Grass
herbs.desc: The old herbalists say it feeds what the body cannot.

herbs.name: Heavenly Meridian Vine
herbs.desc: It climbs the meridian line of the body and flowers where it knots.

herbs.name: Voiddew Flower
herbs.desc: Its dew does not fall so much as go somewhere else.

herbs.name: Thousand-Year Jade Ginseng
herbs.desc: A thousand years of slow growth, and the root is green as jade.

herbs.name: Phoenix Feather Flower
herbs.desc: The petal keeps unfolding, as if the bird were still rising.

herbs.name: Profound Dao Orchid
herbs.desc: The orchid does not bloom for the eye. It blooms for the Dao.

herbs.name: Five-Colored Heavenly Lotus
herbs.desc: Five colours, one breath. The old masters call it a small miracle.

herbs.name: Dragon Vein Mushroom
herbs.desc: A pale cap veined with gold, and a heart of packed stone.

herbs.name: Heaven-Reversal Root
herbs.desc: Pulled at the right hour, it turns a lifetime of qi around.

herbs.name: Golden Soul Lotus
herbs.desc: It grows at the bottom of a pool that has never seen the sun.

herbs.name: Nine Suns Sacred Fruit
herbs.desc: Nine little suns in one rind. The heat inside never goes out.

herbs.name: Voidheart Flower
herbs.desc: It beats once an hour, in a place that has no air.

herbs.name: Dao-Heart Sacred Flower
herbs.desc: The centre of the bloom is a heart, and the heart is still.

herbs.name: Heavenly Dao Vine
herbs.desc: The vine writes the Dao in its bark, and every letter is a meridian.

herbs.name: Worldtree Blossom
herbs.desc: One blossom of the tree that holds the world up.

herbs.name: Timeweaver Orchid
herbs.desc: It opens once, and the moment it opens is the moment you chose.

herbs.name: Undying Soulflower
herbs.desc: It has been blooming since the first soul, and it has not tired.

herbs.name: Nine-Colored Immortal Lotus
herbs.desc: Nine colours, and the tenth only shows itself to the immortal.

herbs.name: Chaos-Origin Lotus
herbs.desc: It grows in the raw noise, before the world decided on a shape.

herbs.name: World Creation Flower
herbs.desc: The first flower, still opening, still deciding what a petal is.

herbs.name: Eternal Genesis Root
herbs.desc: The root under the root under the root, older than the first name.

herbs.name: Ten-Thousand Dao Flower
herbs.desc: Ten thousand petals, one for every path that was ever walked.

herbs.name: Dao-Transcending Flower
herbs.desc: It is beyond the Dao, which is why the Dao cannot describe it.
